name: Do I need permits for a home addition in Berkeley or Oakland?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a home addition in Berkeley or Oakland?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, almost all home additions require permits from the local building department in cities like Berkeley, Oakland, and El Cerrito. These permits ensure that your addition meets safety codes and zoning regulations. Frasheski Construction assists clients throughout the permitting process, from preparing architectural plans to submitting applications and coordinating inspections.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, permits are required for home additions in cities like Berkeley and Oakland to ensure safety and compliance.
